Legal holds, recovery anchors, the automatic keep on each Project's latest 25 runs, live references and backups override expiry; existing authorized retention extensions and rollback/maintenance protections remain. Retries, replay, recovery and observation do not reset run completion. This is the approved G28 row, "The 2 restore-point records: Run year," applied to the two original RT-G28 safe-point names, not to the separate Chat restore_point.* families. The source premises remain CV-557, FileSafe F2-213 and the required real run in the closed own payload. Released snapshot/body lifetimes and original restore journals remain separate under their existing policies. This binding decides no application-scope FileSafe security-event retention rule and grants no access to deleted or inaccessible bodies.
